He played [[college basketball]] for the [[South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball|South Carolina Gamecocks]] of the [[Southeastern Conference]] (SEC). ==Early life== Murray-Boyles was born on June 10, 2005{{Cite web|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Collin-Murray-Boyles/Summary/202374|publisher=[[RealGM]]|title=Collin Murray-Boyles}} and hails from [[Columbia, South Carolina]]. He attended [[A.C. Flora High School]] in [[Forest Acres, South Carolina]], where he was named the Class 4A Player of the Year as a [[Junior (education year)|junior]] after helping Flora reach the state championship while averaging 18.3 points, 11.4 rebounds and 5.3 blocks.{{Cite web|url=https://www.wltx.com/article/sports/collin-murray-boyles-commits-to-south-carolina/101-8854985d-1bff-468e-a767-e4723f0be11f|publisher=[[WLTX]]|title=Collin Murray-Boyles commits to Gamecocks|date=August 7, 2022|author=Mack, Chandler}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.thestate.com/sports/college/university-of-south-carolina/usc-recruiting/article262695997.html|newspaper=[[The State (newspaper)|The State]]|url-access=subscription|title=Lamont Paris, Gamecocks offer hometown Class of 2023 forward |date=June 22, 2022|author=Bezjak, Lou}} He transferred to [[Wasatch Academy]] in [[Mount Pleasant, Utah]], for his [[Senior (education)|senior]] season, and posted a team-leading average of 15.0 points and 8.8 rebounds per game; he was first in the conference in rebounds and third in points scored.{{Cite web|url=https://www.wltx.com/article/sports/ncaa/usc-gamecocks/gamecock-basketball/101-c873524d-153a-4bd9-8f67-37952037dbed|publisher=[[WLTX]]|title=South Carolina freshman, former A.C. Flora star is out indefinitely with mono|date=November 1, 2023|author=Anderson, Reggie}} He was ranked a consensus four-star recruit and a top-100 player nationally following his performance at Wasatch.{{Cite news|url=https://www.newspapers.com/article/the-state/142895472/|newspaper=[[The State (newspaper)|The State]]|via=[[Newspapers.com]]|date=October 31, 2023|page=B1, [https://www.newspapers.com/article/the-state/142895743/ B2]|author=Bezjak, Lou|title=Hometown star looks to make splash for Gamecocks}} {{Open access}} He committed to play [[college basketball]] for the [[South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball|South Carolina Gamecocks]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.on3.com/teams/south-carolina-gamecocks/news/south-carolina-basketball-lands-2023-forward-collin-murray-boyles/|website=On3.com|title=Collin Murray-Boyles commits to South Carolina, discusses decision|author=Taylor, Collyn|date=August 7, 2022}} ==College career== Prior to the 2023–24 season at South Carolina, Murray-Boyles contracted [[infectious mononucleosis]], resulting in him missing significant time.{{Cite news|url=https://www.postandcourier.com/sports/carolina/gamecocks-basketball-collin-murray-boyles-freshman-illness/article_58c97a8c-78c8-11ee-8aae-0b8b2159f709.html|newspaper=[[Post and Murray-Boyles is a new starter for USC basketball|author=Hricik, Madison}} {{Open access}} He became a top player upon returning, including being named the [[Southeastern Conference]] (SEC) Freshman of the Week in February after performances that included a 31-point game over [[2023–24 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbilt]].{{Cite college basketball's best freshmen: South Carolina's Collin Murray-Boyles earns Freshman of the Week|author=Salerno, Cameron|date=13 February 2024 }}{{Cite Murray-Boyles Quickly Becoming Key Player On South Carolina's MBB Team|date=February 7, 2024|author=Lyon, Andrew}} At the conclusion of the regular season, Murray-Boyles was named to the SEC All-Freshman Team.{{cite press release |url=https://www.secsports.com/news/2024/03/2024-sec-mens-basketball-awards-announced |title=2024 SEC Men's Basketball Awards announced |publisher=Southeastern Conference |date=March 11, 2024 |access-date=March 11, 2024}} Following the conclusion of his sophomore season, he declared for the [[2025 NBA Draft]] and received a green room invite in the second wave.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com.au/nba/story/_/id/45525667/six-more-players-receive-nba-draft-green-room-invites |title=Sources: Six more receive NBA green room invites }} ==References==
